forgotPassword.hero.title: We send you a link and you keep working
forgotPassword.hero.body: Until you use it, your current password keeps working. The link works once, and asking for another cancels the previous one.
forgotPassword.title: Recover password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email you a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.tenantSlug.help: The one from your last sign-in. Leave it blank if you're a user of the original system.
forgotPassword.email.label: Email
forgotPassword.email.hint: The email you registered your account with.
forgotPassword.sent.title: Check your inbox
forgotPassword.sentBody: If the details match an account, you'll receive a link to create your password in the next few minutes.
forgotPassword.sent.note: Check your spam folder too. If it doesn't arrive, ask again: the previous link is cancelled.
forgotPassword.rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
forgotPassword.rateLimited.message: Five links were requested in a short time from this connection. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
forgotPassword.rateLimited.note: If you already received a link, it still works as long as you don't ask for another.
forgotPassword.serverError.title: Can't reach the server
forgotPassword.error: Check your connection and try again. No link was sent.
resetPassword.hero.title: You choose it and nobody else sees it
resetPassword.hero.body: Saving it takes you straight into the panel. Your other open sessions close and this link stops working.
resetPassword.title: Create your new password
resetPassword.subtitle: It replaces the previous one and closes your other open sessions.
resetPassword.newPassword.label: New password
resetPassword.done.title: Password ready
resetPassword.invalid.title: This link no longer works
resetPassword.invalid.message: It may have expired, been used already, or been replaced by a newer one. Ask for another and it arrives in a few minutes.
resetPassword.rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
resetPassword.rateLimited.message: Wait {{minutes}} minutes before trying again. The link is still valid.
resetPassword.error.server.title: We couldn't save it
resetPassword.error.server.message: Your password did not change and the link still works. Try again.
resetPassword.setup.hero.title: Your workspace is already set up
resetPassword.setup.hero.body: Projects, users, hours and invoices are waiting inside. All that's missing is the password you'll sign in with.
resetPassword.setup.title: Activate your account
resetPassword.setup.subtitle: This is your username. Choose the password you'll sign in with: nobody else knows it.
resetPassword.setup.newPassword.label: Your password
changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.subtitle: One step before you start working.
changePassword.notice.title: This password isn't yours yet
changePassword.notice.message: It was created for you by an administrator, who also knows it. Choose your own to continue — until you do, the rest of the app stays locked.
changePassword.currentPassword.label: Temporary password
changePassword.currentPassword.placehold: The one you just signed in with
changePassword.currentPassword.required: Enter the password you signed in with
changePassword.newPassword.label: New password
changePassword.newPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
changePassword.error.credentials.title: That password doesn't match
changePassword.error.credentials.message: Type the temporary password exactly as you received it.
changePassword.error.unchanged.title: Pick a different password
changePassword.error.unchanged.message: The new password has to be different from the temporary one.
changePassword.error.server.title: Can't reach the server
changePassword.error.server.message: Check your connection and try again.
login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Admin Portal
login.tenantSlug.label: Company identifier
login.tenantSlug.help: The one you chose at signup. Leave blank if you're a user of the original system.
login.username.label: Username
login.password.label: Password
login.error.invalidCredentials.title: We could not sign you in
login.error.invalidCredentials.message: The username or password does not match. Check the company identifier too.
login.error.accessRestricted.title: Access restricted
login.error.accessRestricted.message: Your user or your company is deactivated in BuildTrack. Talk to your company's administrator.
login.error.serverDown.title: Can't reach the server
login.error.serverDown.message: Check your connection and try again. If it persists, the panel may be under maintenance.
login.error.sessionExpired.title: Session expired
login.error.sessionExpired.message: For your security we closed your session. Sign in again to continue.
login.hero.title: Your jobsites, your crew and your money
login.hero.body: Geofenced clock-ins from the phone, approved hours, payroll, invoices and budgets. All in one panel.
login.error.accessRestricted.tenant: The company is suspended in BuildTrack. Talk to your company's administrator or to support.
login.error.staleSession.title: A previous session is still stored
login.error.staleSession.message: It is not your password: this browser still holds a previous session the server already closed, and that is what it rejected. Clear this site's cookies or sign in from a private window.
acceptInvite.hero.title: {{tenant}} is waiting for you
acceptInvite.hero.body: {{name}} invited you as {{role}}. Create your account and go straight to the projects assigned to you.
acceptInvite.hero.bodyNoInviter: You've been invited as {{role}}. Create your account and go straight to the projects assigned to you.
acceptInvite.hero.bodyGeneric: Create your account with the link you were sent and go straight into the panel.
acceptInvite.title: Create your account
acceptInvite.subtitle: You're invited to join {{tenant}} as {{role}}.
acceptInvite.fullName.label: Full name
acceptInvite.username.label: Username
acceptInvite.username.hint: Letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore. You sign in with it.
acceptInvite.username.pattern: Letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore only.
acceptInvite.password.label: Password
acceptInvite.done.title: Account created
acceptInvite.invalid.title: This invitation no longer works
acceptInvite.invalid.message: It may have expired, been used already, or been cancelled. Ask whoever invited you for another one.
acceptInvite.error.validation.title: Check the fields
acceptInvite.error.rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
acceptInvite.error.rateLimited.message: Too many attempts from this connection. Wait {{minutes}} minutes. Your invitation was not used up.
acceptInvite.error.server.title: We couldn't create your account
acceptInvite.error.server.message: The invitation is still valid. Try again in a moment.
invite.modal.title: Invite a new user
invite.modal.subtitle: Select the role and share the QR (or link) with the person.
invite.modal.role.label: Role
invite.modal.email.label: Email (optional)
invite.modal.email.hint: If provided, we'll also email the invite link.
invite.modal.emailedTo: We also emailed the link to {{email}}.
invite.modal.subcontractor.note: Subcontractors are created manually — use the Create User form instead.
invite.modal.qrHint: The person scans the QR (or uses the link) to create their account.
invite.modal.error: Could not generate the invitation. Try again.
invite.modal.rateLimited: Too many invitations sent recently. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
